day_shape: 74 items: Kuwait drone attack killing two Italians dominates with Iran denials and 'false flag' claims, IDF strikes Hezbollah Radwan rockets in Beqaa Valley, Khamenei issues Basij Week message, Germany arrests two over synagogue plot, IAEA-adjacent US institute flags new underground complex near nuclear sites.

threads.label: Kuwait drone attack fallout
threads.summary: Arab governments condemned Iran and the European Commission president urged pressure on Tehran after a drone attack killed two Italian technicians in Kuwait, while Tehran denied involvement. Foreign Minister Araghchi phoned Kuwaiti and Italian counterparts rejecting the allegations; Iranian commentators and Defa Press pushed a 'Ukrainian false flag' theory.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck dozens of Hezbollah Radwan Force rockets and launchers at a training camp near Ayn al-Tina in the Beqaa Valley, roughly 25km north of the Israeli border. Netanyahu and Katz confirmed an overnight Gaza strike killing senior Hamas official Khaled Abu Nada, who managed the group's economy and education portfolios.

threads.label: Khamenei Basij Week messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office issued a message for Basij Week calling for a 'new birth' of the organisation and the slogan 'every Iranian a Basiji', amplified across multiple IRIB and Defa Press posts. Quds Force commander Qaani and SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei issued accompanying tributes; Jerusalem Post framed the expansion call via Mojtaba Khamenei.

threads.label: Iran nuclear and missile capability reports
threads.summary: A Washington-based institute said Iran is rapidly constructing a fortified underground complex between two main nuclear sites that could house weapons systems or programme infrastructure. A separate report cited by Jerusalem Post and Defa Press said Tehran is developing new ballistic missile variants with improved accuracy and harder interception, weighed against the US naval blockade.

threads.label: Iran economy, sanctions and Hormuz
threads.summary: Araghchi said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until Iran's demands are met, while lawmakers and analysts accused the Pezeshkian administration of self-inflicted damage via currency rules compounding US sanctions pressure. Iran International reported truckers' strikes spread to 18 cities on their fifth day.

threads.label: Western pressure on Iran: Germany, France, CENTCOM
threads.summary: German federal police arrested two Iraqi nationals suspected of belonging to a pro-Iranian group that plotted synagogue attacks in Cologne, while France urged Iran to halt executions at a Paris gathering, drawing a rebuke from Araghchi. CENTCOM said Syrian forces seized IRGC weapons bound for Lebanon.

threads.label: Yemen–Saudi exchanges
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the Saudi-led coalition destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform after Houthi attacks on Aramco's Jazan refinery. Defa Press claimed 109 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen in 24 hours killed civilians in Taiz, and reported Yemeni drone strikes on southern Saudi Arabia.

events.title: The IDF confirms carrying out airstrikes in Lebanon a short while ago, saying it struck dozens of Hezbollah rockets and launchers. The strikes were carried out near the town of Ayn al-Tina, in the Beqaa Valley, some 25 kilometers north of the Israeli border. The military says it struck dozens of rockets and launchers at a military training camp belonging to Hezbollah's elite Radwan Force. "The rockets and launchers were intended for use by Hezbollah terrorists to target IDF soldiers and Israeli civilians, and were struck from the air to eliminate the threat," the army says.
